subject: Re: Novara — Hosted API: Data residency & retention Q&A
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novara-systems.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@novara-systems.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API questions — residency & retention (short list)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. We have a short list of clarifying items for our security review. Please confirm for the Redwood Hosted API:  

1) Where is customer request data (payloads+responses) physically stored by default? Can data be pinned to a specific region?
2) What are your default retention windows for: request logs, generated content (responses), embeddings, and debug traces?
3) How are deletion/erasure requests handled — timeline and scope (backups, replicas, logs)?
4) Do you retain any customer-derived artifacts used for tuning or model improvement? If so, how long and how to opt out?
5) Do you provide attestation or a deletion report for a tenant erasure?

We'd appreciate brief answers and any artifacts you can share (diagram or summary PDF).

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Sr. Information Security Manager — Novara Systems
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novara-systems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API questions — residency & retention (short list)

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. I'm attaching a concise answers PDF and a small dataflow diagram; below is a short summary we can use in your security questionnaire. If you need deeper detail (S3 bucket ARNs, encryption key ids, or SOC evidence) flag that and we'll route it to our security team.

Summary (hosted API):
- Residency: Customer request payloads and generated outputs are stored in region-specific object stores by default. Customers may request a specific region at onboarding; we also support region pinning for enterprise accounts (dedicated routing).
- Retention windows (defaults): request logs: 30 days; generated responses: 30 days; embeddings: 90 days (used only if customer opts into embedding storage); debug traces/error traces: 7 days (retained for troubleshooting only).
- Deletion/erasure: Standard tenant erasure request triggers removal from active stores within 48 hours and from rolling backups within 30 days. We provide a deletion report indicating which storage classes and snapshots were cleaned.
- Derived artifacts: We do not use customer request/response content for model training unless a customer explicitly opts in via the Contracted Data Use agreement. Opt-outs are available via the Console and via written request to privacy@redwood.ai.
- Attestation: We can generate a deletion attestation (PDF) and confirm job completion times, plus the HubSpot ticket ID for traceability.

I want internal confirmation on two specifics before I send the package to Elena: 1) the exact backup retention for hosted API snapshots (is it 30 days or 21?), 2) the precise wording we use for embedding retention when a customer has not opted in.

Marissa / Irene / Soojin — can you confirm those two points?

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API questions — residency & retention (short list)

Markus — quick answers inline.

> 1) backup retention for hosted API snapshots (is it 30 days or 21?)
- We run daily snapshots; standard hosted snapshots are retained for 30 days. For Dedicated/Private customers we can negotiate longer retention.

> 2) wording for embedding retention when a customer has not opted in
- Suggested wording: "Embeddings generated via the Hosted API are deleted within 90 days by default. Embeddings will only be stored for longer if explicit consent is provided for embeddings retention or model-improvement workflows."

Also attaching the mini diagram with storage classes annotated. Irene — please confirm there isn't any additional retention for compacted logs that would extend beyond 30 days.

-M
Marissa Cole
Customer Security Liaison

Attachment: dataflow-hostedapi-novara-diagram.png (stencil)
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 08:59:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API questions — residency & retention (short list)

All good to send. Additional clarifications to include in the PDF:

- Backups: daily snapshots retained 30 days; point-in-time replicas used for failover are rotated and kept no longer than 7 days in hot replicas. Cold backups stored for troubleshooting/restore are purged on a 30-day cadence.
- Logs: Aggregated operational logs (for billing/usage) are retained for 365 days but are anonymized and accessible only via aggregated reports — raw request bodies are not included in long-term billing logs.
- Deletion proof: The deletion attestation will include timestamped job IDs and the storage classes targeted (hot object store, replication, snapshot ids). We do not provide low-level storage access but will deliver the attestation and ticket references.
- Embeddings: confirm Marissa's suggested wording.

I also recommend we include an example erasure report stub in the attachment.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novara-systems.com>

Elena —

Thanks for the questions. Attached are: (1) Redwood_HostedAPI_Data_Residency_Retention_Answers_20260818.pdf (concise answers and a sample erasure attestation), and (2) dataflow-hostedapi-novara-diagram.png (storage classes & region mapping). Key points below (short):

- Region & residency: Default storage follows the region of the dataset routing (you can request us to pin to a specific region at onboarding). Enterprise accounts can request strict region-only routing and additional contractual controls.
- Retention (defaults): request logs: 30 days; generated outputs: 30 days; embeddings: 90 days (only if embedding storage is enabled/opted-in); debug traces: 7 days; backups/snapshots: 30 days. Aggregated billing/usage logs: 365 days (anonymized).
- Erasure: tenant erasure jobs remove items from active stores within 48 hours; snapshot and backup purges complete within 30 days. We will provide a deletion attestation with job ids and timestamps when the erasure completes.
- Model training: we do not include customer content in model training unless explicitly agreed; opt-out is the default.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min call to walk Novara's security team through the diagram and the sample attestation.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
